title: Translation Validation of SystemVerilog-to-SystemC RTL Conversion by Reading the Generated C++
abstract: arXiv:2611.31674v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: SystemC models of register-transfer level (RTL) designs are used for virtual platforms, firmware bring-up and simulation without a commercial license, and more of them now come from translators and language models. A wrong model usually compiles, and it usually agrees with the RTL. SystemVerilog evaluates an 8-bit sum in 8 bits while C++ evaluates it in 64, so a translation that forgets one truncation keeps a carry the RTL drops, and only inputs near the top of the range show it. I built svcc, an open-source SystemVerilog-to-SystemC converter, and my first check of its output read the generated C++ with SystemVerilog's rules. That check passed two wrong models. The check that replaced it gives the generated header the meaning C++17 and SystemC give it and turns undefined behavior into proof obligations. It prints what it read as SystemVerilog with every width change explicit, then proves that equivalent to a netlist of the source by in

translated_title: 通过阅读生成的C++代码实现SystemVerilog到SystemC RTL转换的翻译验证
translated_abstract: 寄存器传输级（RTL）设计的SystemC模型被用于虚拟平台、固件启动调试以及无需商业许可证的仿真，如今越来越多的此类模型来自自动转换器和语言模型。错误的模型通常能够编译通过，并且在大多数情况下与RTL行为一致。SystemVerilog以8位宽度计算8位加法，而C++以64位宽度计算，因此忘记一次截断的转换会保留RTL所丢弃的进位，且只有接近数值范围顶部的输入才会暴露这一错误。作者构建了svcc——一个开源的SystemVerilog到SystemC转换器，其最初对输出正确性的检查方式是用SystemVerilog的规则来阅读生成的C++代码，但该检查却放过了两个错误的模型。取代它的检查方法赋予生成的头文件以C++17和SystemC所定义的真正含义，并将未定义行为转化为需要证明的义务。该检查将读取到的内容以SystemVerilog形式打印出来，并使所有位宽变化显式化，进而证明其与源设计的网表等价……
tldr: 本文提出了一种SystemVerilog到SystemC RTL转换的翻译验证方法：按照C++17和SystemC的真实语义解读生成的C++代码、将未定义行为转化为证明义务，并通过显式化所有位宽变化来证明生成代码与源RTL网表等价。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a translation validation approach for SystemVerilog-to-SystemC RTL conversion that interprets the generated C++ according to C++17 and SystemC semantics, turns undefined behavior into proof obligations, and proves equivalence to the source netlist with all width changes made explicit.
